title: Per-stage provider and model selection v0.1
description: One place that says which model each pipeline stage runs on. Before this file the answer lived in eleven `.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatters (as a Claude Code model tier, not a provider slug) and in a scatter of per-role environment variables -- HARNESS_OCR_READER_A_MODEL, HARNESS_REDACTION_MODEL, HARNESS_OPENROUTER_MODEL -- so no single artifact answered 'what ran on what'. An entry may be present and EMPTY: that means 'not decided yet', which is different from a value, and resolution falls through to the environment exactly as it did before.

default.description: Applied to any stage with no entry of its own. Absent means no default, and every stage falls through to the environment.

stages.description: Keyed by the canonical stage name. The vocabulary is the one run_state.schema.json enumerates -- a stage this pipeline cannot open is a typo, not a configuration.

provider.description: A name from llm_providers.SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS. Not enumerated here on purpose: the provider set is code, and duplicating it into a schema would let the two drift.

model.description: Provider-specific slug, e.g. an OpenRouter vendor-prefixed id. Never invented -- an undecided model is an ABSENT key, not a placeholder string.

roles.description: A stage that makes several distinct calls. A role inherits the stage's provider/model unless it overrides them. This exists because P8's two readers are only genuinely independent if they can be given DIFFERENT models -- a single stage-level value cannot express that, and harness-guardrails-dev is explicit that selecting different readers is a per-reader decision.
